diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_launch_template.ng duplicates the launch-template attribute reference already recorded as an implicit dependency.

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is already established transitively through its launch-template dependency and that template's IAM instance profile reference.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng duplicates the implicit dependency from node_role_arn.

The explicit dependency from :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws-auth to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp is redundant because the config map already depends on :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng, which itself depends on the cluster.
The explicit dependency from :resource.time_sleep.wait to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp is already established transitively through its dependencies on the node group and autoscaling group.

When App Mesh tracing is enabled, worker nodes use the node role for X-Ray permissions. Make :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write so instances do not start before that role permission is attached.

When App Mesh tracing is enabled, managed worker nodes use the node role for X-Ray permissions. Make :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write so the node group is not provisioned before that role permission is attached.

The ALB ingress controller is installed with the IRSA role, but its IAM policy attachment is not an implicit dependency of the Helm release. Make module.alb-ingress:resource.helm_release.albingress wait for module.alb-ingress.module.irsa:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa so the controller is not installed before its permissions are attached.

The App Mesh controller is installed with the IRSA role, but its IAM policy attachment is not an implicit dependency of the Helm release. Make module.app-mesh:resource.helm_release.appmesh wait for module.app-mesh.module.irsa:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa so it is not installed before its permissions are attached.

The cluster autoscaler is installed with the IRSA role, but its IAM policy attachment is not an implicit dependency of the Helm release. Make module.cluster-autoscaler:resource.helm_release.autoscaler wait for module.cluster-autoscaler.module.irsa:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa so it is not installed before its permissions are attached.

Make module.container-insights:resource.helm_release.containerinsights wait for module.container-insights.module.irsa:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.irsa so it is not installed before its permissions are attached.
